A certain book has 250 pages, and 21 of
these pages have an illustration. If one of
the book’s pages is selected at random, what
is the probability of selecting a page with an
illustration? (Express your answer as a dec-
imal or fraction, not as a percent.)

There are 20 marbles in the bag: 8 red
marbles, 10 green marbles, and 2 blue mar-
bles. if one of these marbles is selected at
random, what is the probability of selecting
a red marble?

A choir of 48 singers has 12 members who
sing bass. If one singer from the choir is
selected at random, what is the probability
of selecting a singer who sings bass?

Age group Proportion

A sleep study consisted of 59 participants,
